title: Tooling, Security & Collaboration
description: Study inspect command side effects, protect secrets and local data, review diffs and explain changes, and manage dependencies and reproducibility. Each lesson includes a worked example and an applied practice task.

lessons.title: Inspect command side effects
lessons.description: Replace string interpolation with an argument-safe interface.
lessons.conceptOverview: Understand a command's working directory, writes and external effects before running it. Treat shell strings as code and use safe argument handling for untrusted values.
lessons.whyItMatters: Untrusted strings must not become executable shell syntax.
lessons.engineerDeepDive: Understand a command's working directory, writes and external effects before running it. Treat shell strings as code and use safe argument handling for untrusted values.

sections.title: Concept
sections.content: Understand a command's working directory, writes and external effects before running it. Treat shell strings as code and use safe argument handling for untrusted values.

sections.title: Worked example
sections.content: A filename containing shell metacharacters is interpolated into a command string.

sections.title: Practice & verification
sections.content: Replace string interpolation with an argument-safe interface. Write down your reasoning and check it against the concept before continuing.

keyTakeaways: Untrusted strings must not become executable shell syntax.
commonMistakes: Quoting with arbitrary string formatting always prevents shell execution.

lessons.title: Protect secrets and local data
lessons.description: Define a redaction step and an exposure response.
lessons.conceptOverview: Avoid placing credentials in source, prompts or logs. Use project-approved secret handling and inspect generated artifacts before sharing them outside the workspace.
lessons.whyItMatters: Artifacts and logs need secret review before sharing.
lessons.engineerDeepDive: Avoid placing credentials in source, prompts or logs. Use project-approved secret handling and inspect generated artifacts before sharing them outside the workspace.

lessons.title: Review diffs and explain changes
lessons.description: Identify the meaningful change and reduce unrelated churn where safe.
lessons.conceptOverview: Review the final diff for unintended files, behavioral completeness and compatibility. Explain the problem, resulting behavior and validation so another developer can assess the change efficiently.
lessons.whyItMatters: A reviewable change makes intent and validation clear.

lessons.title: Manage dependencies and reproducibility
lessons.description: Compare a local implementation with the dependency's compatibility requirements.
lessons.conceptOverview: Use the repository's lockfiles and installed versions as the starting point. New dependencies add compatibility and maintenance costs, so justify them and verify reproducible installation.
lessons.whyItMatters: Dependency choices must fit the project's runtime and build constraints.
